:::{#def-predicted-probability}
#### Predicted probability

The **predicted probability** of [class](#def-class) $k$ at [features](model-validation.qmd#def-feature) $\predvar$ is
the [conditional probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-conditional-prob) of that class given those features, under a model:

$$\ep_k(\predvar) \eqdef \Prf{\Outvar = k \given \predvar}$$ {#eq-predicted-probability}

When the model is [fitted](model-validation.qmd#def-fitted-model),
the predicted probability is an [estimate](estimation.qmd#def-estimate) of the true conditional probability.
The two can differ, because a fitted model only approximates the true relationship.

:::
